verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a data and AI platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core Databricks platform. It shows only managed offerings: a pay-as-you-go cloud service, a free trial, and a hosted Free Edition workspace. Community comments about building DIY stacks describe alternatives to Databricks, not a Databricks capability, so they earn no credit.
